title.zh: 动物与鸟类（指定动物类别）规则 2015
title.en: Animals and Birds (Prescribed Classes of Animals) Rules 2015

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. These Rules may be cited as the Animals and Birds (Prescribed Classes of Animals) Rules 2015 and come into operation on 16 December 2015.
2. For the purposes of the definition of “animal” in section 2(1) of the Act, the classes of animals that are prescribed for the purposes of the Act are reptiles and amphibians.
